articles.title: iCloud+ Hide My Email addresses will remain on icloud.com
articles.zh: iCloud+ 隐藏邮件地址将继续保留在 icloud.com 上
articles.summary: 如果你在用 iCloud+ 的隐藏邮件功能管理账号，这个更新提醒你这些地址的管理入口仍然在网页端，不会迁移或消失
articles.body:
Starting later this year, new Sign in with Apple addresses, previously issued on privaterelay.appleid.com , will be issued on private.icloud.com . Existing addresses on privaterelay.appleid.com will continue to work and forward mail to users without interruption.

After further consideration and reviewing community feedback, iCloud+ Hide My Email addresses will remain on icloud.com .

Developers with apps or websites that use Sign in with Apple should ensure that their account systems, email validation logic, and allowlists accept addresses on the new private.icloud.com domain in addition to the existing privaterelay.appleid.com domain.

Learn more about Sign in with Apple

Communicating using the Private Email Relay Service
articles.bodyZh:
从今年晚些时候开始，苹果“通过Apple登录”（Sign in with Apple）的新地址将从原先的privaterelay.appleid.com域名，改用private.icloud.com域名发放。之前已经分配出去的privaterelay.appleid.com地址照常能用，邮件转发不会中断，大家不用担心。

苹果在进一步考虑并听取社区反馈之后，决定把iCloud+的“隐藏邮件地址”（Hide My Email）功能继续保留在icloud.com域名上，不做迁移。

如果你的应用或网站接入了“通过Apple登录”，记得在账号系统、邮箱验证逻辑还有白名单里，除了现有的privaterelay.appleid.com域名之外，也要把新的private.icloud.com域名加进去，免得老用户和新地址的用户出问题。

想了解更多，可以访问“通过Apple登录”的官方介绍页面。

（本段涉及的是通过“私密邮件转发服务”进行邮件通信的相关内容。）

articles.title: Show HN: PicoMQ – Durable Streams over HTTP, on object storage
articles.zh: Show HN：PicoMQ——基于对象存储的 HTTP 持久化流
articles.summary: 如果你需要简单可靠的消息队列，PicoMQ 把对象存储当后端，可能帮你替代 Kafka 这类重设施
articles.body:
PicoMQ is durable, real-time streams over HTTP, built on S3-compatible object storage.

Pico, from Latin picus ‘woodpecker’ (family Picidae).

Traviès, Dendrocopos major . Wikimedia Commons (PD).

Create a stream per use case instead of packing every record of a kind into one topic. Each stream is independently addressable, bottomless, and can scale from idle to high throughput.
articles.bodyZh:
PicoMQ 是一个基于 HTTP 的实时消息流系统，底层用的是兼容 S3 的对象存储（object storage），数据既能持久保存，又能实时传输，可靠不丢。

Pico 这名字来自拉丁语 picus，意思是“啄木鸟”（啄木鸟科）。（上图是 Traviès 画的斑啄木鸟（Dendrocopos major），来自维基共享资源，公有领域。）

用法上，建议每个使用场景单独建一条流（stream），而不是把同一类记录全塞进一个主题（topic）里。每条流都独立可寻址、容量没有上限，从闲置状态到高吞吐都能平滑扩展。

articles.title: How to Train a Critic Stably and Efficiently
articles.zh: 如何稳定且高效地训练Critic模型（价值网络训练中的稳定性与效率方法）
articles.summary: 如果你在做强化学习或RLHF相关项目，Critic模型训练不稳是你大概率踩过的坑，这篇给出了系统性的解法
articles.author: Penghui Qi, Xiangxin Zhou 等
articles.body: Group-based reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO for large language models avoid training a critic by sampling multiple responses for each prompt. A reliable critic could instead estimate token-level advantages from one response, but standard critic-based training recipes are often unstable. We study this instability and develop \textbf{Best-Practice Critic Optimization (BPCO)}, a recipe that combines DPPO, value predictions bounded to the reward range, Monte Carlo value targets, unnormalized policy advantages, and length-adaptive generalized advantage estimation. Because the critic is used only during training, BPCO can also condition it on reward-defining information, such as a reference answer or grading rubric, that is hidden from the policy. Controlled experiments isolate the effect of each design choice. Across mathematical reasoning tasks with models ranging from 1.5B parameters to 30B-A3B mixtures of experts, BPCO improves a strong critic-based baseline consistently, and matches or exceeds a group-based baseline while sampling one response per prompt. The same recipe also improves learning with rubric-based rewards. These results show that a carefully designed critic provides a reliable alternative to group-relative advantage estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/QPHutu/golden_critic

articles.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
articles.zh: ReWorld：具备长时记忆的交互式世界模型
articles.summary: 如果你关心AI Agent在复杂环境中的长期规划能力，这个带长时记忆的世界模型可能是解决"记不住事"的一个重要方向
articles.author: Zhifei Chen, Luozhou Wang 等
articles.body: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.
articles.bodyZh:
一个交互式世界模型（interactive world model），必须能跟着用户的操作走，记住它展示过的地方，还要实时地生成画面。这里有个结构性的矛盾：控制希望你只看眼前，记忆却希望你永不遗忘。ReWorld 的做法是，训练的时候把这两件事分开，推理的时候再给它们加上边界。

它采用混合的逐头注意力窗口（per-head attention window）：大多数“头”只关注最近一小段历史，一小撮“全局头”则能看遍整个历史；同时用随机的头路由（head routing）防止某种能力固定绑在特定头上；随机丢弃数据块，让稀疏的历史也变成模型熟悉的输入分布。

推理的时候，所有历史都被塞进一个固定预算里：一个容量有限的 KV 缓存（KV cache），背后是一个按位姿索引的地标库（pose-indexed landmark bank）。模型只从里面取离当前位姿最近的那些地标。

数据引擎把八个来源——虚幻引擎渲染的飞越镜头、游戏里的自由漫游、还有真实世界视频——都对齐到同一个物理动作尺度上。这样，不管在哪个来源里，按下同一个键，镜头移动的距离都一样。另外，它还制造了“回文轨迹”（先出去再原路返回）来提供记忆训练需要的“重访”证据。

接下来，只在 LoRA 适配器上做分布匹配蒸馏（distribution-matching distillation），把采样压缩到四步。这样一来，同一个主干网络（backbone）既能跑高保真的多步模式，也能跑实时的交互模式，在照片级写实、游戏风格、风格化世界里都能流式输出 704x1280 的视频。

在动作跟随、长程记忆、视频质量这三个维度的评测协议下，跟六个近期的交互式世界模型相比，ReWorld 的控制保真度最好（旋转误差 11.95°，镜头运动一致性也最佳），生成质量也最高。在一分钟的往返 rollout（64 秒，384 个潜变量）里，它那固定的 12 块缓存依然能重建出起始画面；而同样的长度下，滑窗（sliding window）早就把证据挤出去了，全 KV 注意力则直接内存爆炸。

articles.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?
articles.zh: SWE Refactor Bench：编码Agent能否完成长周期、全仓库级别的技术栈迁移？
articles.summary: 如果你在做AI编程工具或Agent测评，这篇告诉你当前Agent在真实项目重构场景下能走多远、卡点在哪
articles.author: Deyao Hong, Yizhe Chi 等
articles.body: Modern software systems accumulate technical debt over decades of development, which makes migration expensive and largely manual. As coding agents become increasingly capable at bug fixing, can they autonomously perform such migrations? Existing benchmarks cannot answer this question because they evaluate only behavioural correctness, not whether the migration actually occurred. This leads an easy hack: agents copy the original implementation to make tests pass. We call this Blindness. To address this problem, we introduce SWE Refactor Bench, a benchmark comprising 20 whole-repository migrations, covering 4 kinds of technical debt. A three-stage evaluation protocol measures both migration completeness and behavioural correctness. (1) Migration Audit verifies that the migration occurred. (2) Behavioural Tests measure correctness with a fixed test suite. (3) Agentic Verification uses 6 independent coding agents to generate targeted tests for hidden behavioural differences. Across 520 runs from 8 frontier models and 26 model-effort configurations, only 28 of 520 runs ($5.4\%$) pass all three stages, 13 of the 20 tasks receive no accepted solution, and the best model (claude-opus-5) scores $47.0/100$. Migration completeness and behavioural correctness are distinct abilities: a few runs preserve behaviour by skipping the migration and are stopped at Migration Audit; most attempt it and break behaviour, and are stopped at Behavioural Tests. Agents cannot deliver a perfect migration: among the 340 runs that pass Migration Audit, $58\%$ reach $99\%$ of the fixed checks, yet only $26\%$ reach $100\%$. Agent capability differs across migration categories: agents score $31.4$ on build toolchain rewrites but only $5.6$ on language rewrites. Together, these findings position SWE Refactor Bench as a rigorous testbed for developing coding agents for reliable whole-repository migrations.
articles.bodyZh:
现代软件系统在几十年的开发过程中会不断积累技术债（technical debt），这让迁移变得又贵又费人力。既然编码智能体（coding agent）修 bug 的能力越来越强，那它们能不能自主完成这类迁移呢？现有基准测试回答不了这个问题，因为它们只验证行为是否正确，不验证迁移是否真的发生了。这就留下了一个漏洞：智能体直接把原始实现复制一遍就能让测试通过。我们把这种问题叫作“盲目性”（Blindness）。

为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 SWE Refactor Bench，一个包含 20 个全仓库迁移任务的基准测试，覆盖 4 类技术债。我们的评估协议分三个阶段，同时考察迁移完成度和行为正确性：（1）迁移审计（Migration Audit）——确认迁移确实发生了；（2）行为测试（Behavioural Tests）——用固定测试套件验证正确性；（3）智能体验证（Agentic Verification）——派 6 个独立编码智能体生成针对性测试，用来找出隐藏的行为差异。

我们跑了 8 个前沿模型、26 种模型-算力配置，共 520 次实验，结果只有 28 次（5.4%）能通过全部三个阶段；20 个任务里有 13 个没有任何一个方案被接受；表现最好的模型（claude-opus-5）也只拿到 47.0/100 分。迁移完成度和行为正确性是两种完全不同的能力：少数几次实验靠跳过迁移来保住行为，在迁移审计阶段就被拦下；大多数实验尝试了迁移但搞坏了行为，在行为测试阶段就被卡住。智能体做不到完美迁移：在通过迁移审计的 340 次实验中，58% 能完成 99% 的固定检查项，但只有 26% 能完成 100%。不同迁移类型对智能体的难度也不一样：在构建工具链重写任务上智能体平均得分 31.4，但在语言重写任务上只有 5.6。总的来说，这些发现让 SWE Refactor Bench 成为一个严格的测试平台，可以用来开发能可靠完成全仓库迁移的编码智能体。

articles.title: EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings
articles.zh: EG-ARSA：面向低资源环境、以专家知识为基础的视觉道路安全审计开源模型
articles.summary: 如果你关注AI在传统行业落地，这套以专家知识驱动的道路安全审计模型，展示了一条不靠堆算力的务实路线
articles.author: Md Thamed Bin Zaman Chowdhury, Moazzem Hossain
articles.body: Road traffic injuries remain a major challenge in low- and middle-income countries, where proactive road safety auditing is limited by incomplete crash records, shortages of qualified auditors, and the high cost of large-scale field inspections. To address this problem, we propose Expert-Grounded Distillation (EGD), a novel artificial intelligence framework that transfers institutional road safety expertise into a compact vision-language model for scalable visual road safety auditing. The key innovation is a quantified expert-grounding stage in which the teacher vision-language model is calibrated against authoritative field audits. Large-scale annotation is permitted only after the teacher reaches substantial agreement with expert risk assessments (Cohen's kappa = 0.74). The calibrated teacher then generates structured supervision that is distilled into an 8-billion-parameter student vision-language model using Low-Rank Adaptation and a single leakage-free prompt. We also introduce Bangladesh Road Safety Audit (BD-ARSA), the first open, expert-grounded Bangladeshi visual road safety audit dataset containing 21,947 image-audit records with near-national coverage, and Expert-Grounded Road Safety Auditor (EG-ARSA), the first vision-language model developed specifically for this task. Experimental results show that grounded fine-tuning substantially improves ordinal risk assessment over the zero-shot baseline, while blind expert evaluation demonstrates that the compact student outperforms both its 31 billion-parameter teacher and Gemini-2.5-Flash. These findings demonstrate that EGD provides an effective and scalable engineering solution for proactive road safety auditing in resource-constrained environments.
articles.bodyZh: 道路交通事故造成的伤亡，在低收入和中等收入国家依然是个大难题。这些地方想主动做道路安全审计，往往有心无力——事故记录不全、专业审计员不够，大规模实地排查又太烧钱。为了解决这个困局，我们提出了一个“专家接地精炼”框架（Expert-Grounded Distillation，简称EGD）。说白了，就是利用人工智能，把机构里那些资深的安全审计经验，转到一个轻量级的视觉语言模型里，让它能做大范围的视觉道路安全审计。这个框架的关键创新，在于一个量化了的“专家接地”环节：先让作为“老师”的视觉语言模型，对照权威的实地审计结果进行校准。只有当老师模型的判断和专家风险评估结果相当一致时（Cohen's kappa系数达到0.74），才允许用它去做大规模标注。校准好了的“老师”会生成结构化的监督信息，然后通过低秩适应（Low-Rank Adaptation）和一种“零泄漏”提示词，把这些经验“蒸馏”给一个只有80亿参数的“学生”视觉语言模型。我们还推出了两个新东西：一个是孟加拉国道路安全审计数据集（BD-ARSA），这是头一个开放、且由专家接地的孟加拉国视觉道路安全审计数据，里面有21,947条带图像的审计记录，基本覆盖了全国；另一个是专门为这个任务打造的视觉语言模型，叫“专家接地道路安全审计员”（EG-ARSA）。实验结果显示，经过接地微调的模型，在做风险等级评估时，比零样本基线模型要准得多；而且，让专家盲评的话，这个紧凑的“学生”模型，居然比它那个310亿参数的“老师”模型，甚至比Gemini-2.5-Flash还要更胜一筹。这些成果说明，EGD这套方案确实又高效、又能规模化推广，很适合用来在资源紧张的地方做主动道路安全审计。

articles.title: Physics-Constrained Deep Learning Model for Contactless Blood Pressure Monitoring from Triaxial Bodyseismography
articles.zh: 基于物理约束深度学习的三轴体震信号无接触血压监测模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做医疗AI或可穿戴设备方向，这篇用物理约束提升模型泛化性的思路，能帮你少走不少弯路
articles.author: Yuanyuan Zhang, Yida Zhang 等
articles.body: Ballistocardiography (BCG) is promising for unobtrusive long-term blood pressure (BP) monitoring in laboratory settings, but traditional BCG signals are vulnerable to the variations in body-bed interaction with shifted fiducial points in temporal or amplitude axis, and BP varies with personal hemodynamic changes, causing misaligned representations that affect model generalizability and robustness. In this work, we propose a non-invasive BP estimation framework, Phy-BP, based on triaxial bodyseismography (BSG) as an extension of BCG. Firstly, an adaptive quality-control algorithm is designed to select BSG segments enriched with cardiogenic components by jointly considering neighboring beat patterns and universal cardiogenic templates. Furthermore, a physical model is established to describe 3D wave propagation in the body-bed system and is subsequently embedded into the deep learning model to characterize the intrinsic coupling among triaxial BSG signals driven by a single cardiogenic excitation. Thus, multi-axis features are aligned during model training, improving robustness against distortions in real scenarios. Experiments on a 162-hour hospital dataset collected from 21 subjects reveal that the proposed Phy-BP can dynamically filter out low-quality measurements, and the deep learning model training is constrained by physical consistency across different axes to provide faithful BP monitoring, especially when training samples are limited.
articles.bodyZh: 心冲击图（BCG）在实验室环境下做不打扰的长期血压监测是很有潜力的，但传统的BCG信号很容易因为身体和床之间的相互作用发生变化而受影响，导致时间轴或幅度轴上的基准点发生偏移。再加上血压本身会跟着个人的血流动力学变化而变动，这样一来，信号的表达就对不齐了，直接影响模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性。在这项工作里，我们提出了一个无创的血压估计框架，叫Phy-BP，它基于三轴体震图（BSG），可以看作是BCG的升级版。首先，我们设计了一个自适应质量控制算法，通过综合相邻心跳模式和通用的心源性模板，把心源性成分丰富的BSG片段挑出来。接着，又建立了一个物理模型，用来描述体-床系统里三维波的传播，然后把它嵌入到深度学习模型里，去刻画在同一个心源性激励下三轴BSG信号之间的内在耦合。这样在训练时，多轴特征就能对齐，对真实场景中的各种变形和干扰也有更强的抵抗力。我们在医院里收集了21个受试者、共162小时的数据做实验，结果显示，Phy-BP能动态地过滤掉低质量的测量数据，而且深度学习模型训练过程中受到不同轴之间物理一致性的约束，使得血压监测的结果更可靠，特别是在训练样本不多的时候。

articles.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
articles.zh: Prime Agent：一个自我改进的RLM（强化学习模型）框架
articles.summary: 如果你在搭建Agent训练管线，这种具备自我改进能力的RLM框架，可能在长期任务上比传统RL更省力
articles.author: Seth Karten, Alex L. Zhang 等
articles.body: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
articles.bodyZh:
语言模型本质上是个“顺序处理器”，但真要完成那些需要长期规划的任务，光靠模型自身的参数和当前上下文里的信息是不够的，还得有外部信息和计算能力的支持。Prime Agent就是为此而生的——一个开源框架，专门用来做长期任务评估和编码智能体（coding agent）的工作流。

它里面内置了一个常驻的IPython交互式环境，遵循“递归语言模型”（Recursive Language Model）的抽象思路，让程序能高效地处理上下文、在测试阶段动态调用算力。同时，“持续框架”（Continual Harness）模块会完整保留每次运行的轨迹记录，包括历史对话、记忆、技能、提示词以及子智能体的配置。递归式的子智能体之间可以直接对话协作，而“智能体视图”（Agents View）功能则让你能随时查看和管理后台运行的各个任务会话。

Prime Agent把执行、恢复、验证和资源统计这些环节都标准化了，但策略怎么制定，它完全交给模型自己去发挥。这个设计巧妙在：它用一层轻便又灵活的外壳，把框架自身的故障和模型能力区分开，这样评估出来的结果就更接近模型真实能达到的上限。

实际效果也很亮眼：在ARC-AGI-3 RHAE测试里，Best@1成绩从原来的30%直接拉到了95.5%；在长上下文编码、GPU内核生成、模拟器搭建，还有自动化的nanoGPT极速训练挑战中，它都跟原生方案和流行的其他框架打平甚至更优。在《异星工厂》（Factorio）里，我们验证了它能让科技树持续迭代推进，而且派出专门的子智能体还能实现并行作业，效率拉满。

代码已开源，地址是 https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent。

articles.title: ConvergeFlow: Language Flow with Provable Convergence to Token Embeddings
articles.zh: ConvergeFlow：可证明收敛到Token嵌入的语言流（模型架构）
articles.summary: 如果你在做序列建模或语言模型底层架构，这篇从理论上保证了收敛性，别被花哨的"流"概念绕晕，关键是它给了一个可证明的收敛路径
articles.author: Na Li, Yuchen Jiao 等
articles.body: Recent advances in continuous diffusion and flow-based language models (LMs) have achieved performance competitive with discrete LMs. However, existing continuous frameworks still rely on decoders supervised with cross entropy (CE) because the flow trajectories are not guaranteed to terminate at valid token embeddings. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce \textbf{ConvergeFlow}, an embedding-space flow-based LM, which constrains the data predictor to the convex hull of token embeddings and trains it solely with the mean squared error objective induced by flow matching. Under suitable regularity conditions, we prove that the resulting flow converges to valid token embeddings despite errors in the data predictor, enabling direct token prediction without a CE-supervised decoder. We further develop three sampling mechanisms for controlling the trade-off between the generative perplexity and entropy. Experiments on OpenWebText demonstrate that ConvergeFlow achieves performance competitive with existing continuous and discrete diffusion LMs. These findings demonstrate the potential of the flow-based paradigm for language modeling. Our code is available at https://github.com/Na-Li66/ConvergeFlow.
articles.bodyZh: 最近，连续扩散和基于流的语言模型（flow-based language model，简称LM）取得了跟离散语言模型不相上下的表现。不过，现有的连续框架还是离不开用交叉熵（cross entropy，简称CE）来监督的解码器，因为流轨迹并不能保证最后落在有效的词嵌入（token embedding）上。为了解决这个短板，我们提出了**ConvergeFlow**——一个在嵌入空间里运作的基于流的语言模型。它把数据预测器限制在词嵌入的凸包（convex hull）内，并且只用流匹配（flow matching）带来的均方误差（mean squared error，简称MSE）作为训练目标。在合适的正则性条件下，我们证明了即使数据预测器有误差，最终的流依然会收敛到有效的词嵌入上，从而直接预测token，不再需要CE监督的解码器。我们还设计了三种采样机制，用来在生成的困惑度（perplexity）和多样性（entropy）之间做权衡。在OpenWebText上的实验表明，ConvergeFlow的表现能和现有的连续及离散扩散语言模型一较高下。这些结果展示了基于流的范式在语言建模上的潜力。我们的代码开源在：https://github.com/Na-Li66/ConvergeFlow。

articles.title: How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles
articles.zh: AI辅助如何影响人类技能发展——基于逻辑谜题学习的研究
articles.summary: 如果你担心"AI用得越多，人越废"这个议题，这篇拿逻辑谜题的实验数据告诉你：辅助方式不同，结果可能完全两样
articles.author: Shang Wu, Catarina G Belem 等
articles.body: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. The results show that greater independent problem-solving effort is associated with larger gains in latent ability, consistent with the interpretation that skill development is weaker when AI assistance substitutes for independent reasoning.
articles.bodyZh: AI辅助这东西，短期看能帮你把活儿干得更漂亮，但长期来看，它可能会让你自己的本事退化。我们用一个逻辑谜题实验来研究这个矛盾：实验里，AI辅助是按需提供的，参与者分别在AI可用之前、期间和之后各完成一轮任务。通过人为调整调用AI的成本，我们发现，调用AI越便宜，大家用得就越频繁。同时，那些在AI可用阶段主动请求AI帮忙的人，在AI撤掉之后，任务表现反而更差。而且，如果只根据他们在有AI辅助时的表现来预测其后续独立表现，会明显高估。我们用一个贝叶斯潜在能力模型（Bayesian latent ability model），把初始能力、AI使用后的能力，以及每个人自身的能力变化分开估算，同时分析在AI可用阶段，参与者的独立推理程度跟能力提升之间的关系。结果发现，独立解题的努力越多，潜在能力的提升就越大。这正好印证了一点：如果AI辅助替代了独立推理，那技能的发展就会相对变弱。
